justification: Colonial Karachi District comprised Karachi plus the Tatta/Shahbandar/Jerruck/Kotri talukas (Imperial Gazetteer, Sind); today Karachi Division, Thatta (incl. Sujawal, not in GADM 4.1) and Jamshoro
Delhi District (Punjab) to 1912 comprised Delhi, Sonepat and Ballabgarh tahsils; GADM 4.1 has a single NCT unit
